artworks.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx
artworks.description: Moreau's encounter at the seven-gated city — the riddle-breaker and the monster Hesiod makes daughter of Orthrus, Apollodorus daughter of Typhon, at the hinge of the Labdacid curse.

artworks.title: The Death of Pentheus
artworks.description: Rubens renders the maenads' tearing of Cadmus' grandson — the king who denied Dionysus and was destroyed by his own mother Agave on Cithaeron.
